defects.description: Description: "Keep the free hand resting on the surface or in a pocket, never stiff at your side." Both wrists stiff at sides: L wrist→L hip dist2D=0.51, R wrist→R hip dist2D=0.32 (threshold <0.25). Right elbow flexion only 20° (nearly straight) — right arm is the "stiff at side" the description explicitly forbids.
Loose-leg soft knee bend too subtle: leftKnee=12 is barely a bend; "soft knee bend" implies ~25-35°.

failing_tests.assertion: right wrist to right hip dist2D < 0.25 for hand-in-pocket
leftKnee in [25,40] for soft knee bend on loose leg

regression_risk: low — moderate risk right wrist may not fully reach <0.25 due to rig constraint (wrist y bound to elbow y). Pose integrity preserved: hip-shift and one-leg-weight-bearing unchanged.
rationale: Right arm is stiff at side (rightElbow=20°, rightShoulder=8° abduction 16°). Per CORRECTED sign convention rightShoulder rotZ -=raise outward. Setting rightShoulder=-25 (raise upper arm outward ~50° abduction) + rightElbow=85 (right-angle flexion, forearm horizontal) brings right hand down toward hip area for hand-in-pocket posture. leftKnee 12→30 for visible "soft knee bend" on loose leg (left leg is forward via leftHip=12, takes non-weight-bearing role). Left arm unchanged (leftElbow=40 already bent, not stiff). Hip-shift (hips=10, pelvic list 10°) and weight-bearing right leg (rightKnee=10 straight) preserved.
